story:
Firefly Contractors ＆ Design is a locally owned, family-run remodeling company based in Otis Orchards, Washington, on a mission to revolutionize residential construction by putting people first and delivering excellence on every project. For 15 years we've helped Spokane-area homeowners protect and reinvent their homes — full roof replacements, new siding, and complete kitchen and bathroom remodels — with a licensed, insured, and bonded team that treats your home like our own.

Our championship mindset shapes every decision: straight talk, clean job sites, and craftsmanship you can point at years later. Whether you need storm-damaged shingles replaced or you're ready to reimagine the way your kitchen lives, Firefly leads with thoughtful design, skilled trades, and a commitment to continuous improvement — all backed by a written workmanship warranty and a name your neighbors know.
